comparisonArms.flat: All model instructions and every sharedCrossDomainFacts entry below.
comparisonArms.native: Exactly the same model instructions and sharedCrossDomainFacts; linked native context is separately sourced, never fabricated from this draft.

sharedCrossDomainFacts: Before any cross-source identity transfer, require compatible profile, seed, generator/identity revision, manifest, per-table and shared-map provenance tied to actual private source bindings. Reused integer keys, friendly aliases and equal refresh timestamps do not prove a shared population; missing evidence blocks transfer.

Keep data, source-model, ontology and context/cache clocks independent of population lineage and business-effective intervals. Compatible sources need not share refresh timestamps; fresh context cannot repair stale source metadata or mixed populations.

Incidents belong to physical Sites. Service Site Map resolves serving-site history; Contracts supplies effective SLA identity and terms. Equal numeric values do not equate site, service, contract, account and billing keys.
Use half-open UTC intervals [start,end). Preserve the actual incident/mapping intersection before testing contract validity. A mapping starting in an earlier month can still apply this month.

Selected incidents restrict the affected contract cohort. Eligible Credits, Applied Credits and Credit Exposure remain whole contract-service-month measures, not marginal credits caused by an individual incident.

Enterprise owns outage-union settlement, threshold per service-month, one monetary cap per contract-month, applied credits and remaining exposure. Do not reconstruct financial calculations in the cross-domain application.

Credit Exposure is signed Eligible Credits minus applied SLA cents from SLA Evaluation, not a nonnegative economic exposure measure. Preserve negative values and separately flag INVALID_SETTLEMENT / OVERAPPLIED_CREDITS at contract-month grain, even when account totals net to zero.

The local synthetic SLA settlement contract requires nonnegative applied SLA cents; a negative Applied Credits amount is independently INVALID_SETTLEMENT / NEGATIVE_APPLIED_CREDITS, even when Credit Exposure is positive. This is not the Finance Charge Lines signed-reversal policy. Preserve the signed subtraction in every case.

Validate Applied Credits against real source contract identity and overlap between its SLA service month and the half-open contract effective period, not incident-cohort membership or posted_at. True orphans and out-of-period postings are invalid; legitimate source contracts outside selected incidents stay outside the incident answer without being labelled orphans. Diagnostic labels are evaluator metadata, not new measures or native Rules.
Finance Credits has account_key, not contract_key. Never allocate its postings to SLA contracts without an additional reviewed attribution source.
Use the same selected service month across SLA and Finance measures. An applied credit's posted_at and a Finance credit's posting month do not redefine its service month.

Contract results are contract-month grain. Account priority combines source-governed account-month SLA aggregates with one Finance account-month revenue/margin result. Never repeat and sum Finance values across contracts.
Cents are integer currency subunits; convert to currency units only for display. Minutes measure duration. Ratio measures are not additive.
No incident cohort is distinct from missing source coverage, missing identity links or denied access. Preserve missing values and report excluded mappings; do not substitute zero.

The reviewed local fixture covers March-August 2026. July is the default incident period; August has no incident cohort. Outside that coverage, request clarification or block rather than infer no exposure.

models.name: Network Operations
instructions: For incident identity and time use 'Incidents'[incident_key], [site_key], [start] and [end]. 'Sites'[site_key] identifies physical sites, not home markets or accounts.

For availability use [Availability Percent] on 'Site Hour'; [Eligible Site Minutes] and [Unavailable Site Minutes] are minute measures at site-hour grain. Do not sum overlapping raw incident durations.
[Major Incidents] counts major incident records by 'Incidents'[month]; incident start-month counts are not a cross-month exposure cohort.
Ask whether a request means incident count, site availability or affected enterprise services when 'impact' is unspecified. Use explicit UTC window overlap for affected-service analysis.

recommendedDescriptions.description: One row per incident_key. UTC [start,end) intervals may overlap; union duration within the required scope. month is the incident start month.
One physical site per site_key. Site identity is not account identity or customer home market.

models.name: Enterprise Services
instructions: Contracts and Service Site Map month is a start-month attribute, not service-month validity. The local template removes their Calendar start-month relationships. Use explicit half-open UTC overlap and project reviewed keys; a March-start mapping can remain valid in July. A separately requested start-month analysis must explicitly select that date role, not imply validity.

No Contracts-to-SLA Evaluation fact relationship is inferred. Filter contract_key explicitly on SLA Evaluation or Applied Credits, the exact home tables of the source measures, using the reviewed cohort. Only the home table's allowed dimensions are legal.
'Service Site Map' is service_key plus valid_from grain; [valid_from,valid_to) defines the serving site and contract. 'Contracts' is effective contract_key grain with its own validity interval.
Use [Eligible Credits] and [Credit Exposure] from 'SLA Evaluation', and [Applied Credits] from 'Applied Credits'. All are cents by SLA service month and permit contract_key grouping.

'SLA Evaluation' is contract_key plus month grain. Credit Exposure is source-owned signed eligible less applied cents, without a zero floor. Negative values indicate overapplication, classified INVALID_SETTLEMENT / OVERAPPLIED_CREDITS; never clamp, apply another incident-level cap or subtract Finance Credits.
[Contracted Recurring Revenue] on 'Service Month' is contracted value, not Finance recognized revenue. Ask which definition is intended when 'revenue' is ambiguous.

An absent Applied Credits posting remains null, distinct from an explicit zero posting; use governed Credit Exposure for the signed residual. A posting with an unknown amount is INCOMPLETE_SETTLEMENT / MISSING_APPLIED_AMOUNT, not zero or a complete total. Do not sum known residuals into a complete account total when a contract amount is unknown.

Negative applied SLA cents violate this local source settlement contract independently of the residual sign. Validate every posting's source contract and service-month overlap, including contracts outside selected incidents; never add those contracts to the incident cohort or treat posted_at as service time.

recommendedDescriptions.description: Cents by contract service month: validity-clipped outage union, threshold per service, then one contract-month cap. Not incremental incident credit.
Applied SLA cents by contract service month. posted_at records the separate posting instant; missing result stays explicit.

Signed eligible minus applied SLA cents per contract-month, no zero floor. Preserve negatives; flag overapplication as invalid settlement. Selected incidents limit contracts, not the month's calculation.

models.name: Billing and Finance
instructions: Use [Recognized Service Revenue] and [Contribution Margin] on 'Account Month' for account-level priority. Both are cents; 'Account Month' is account_key plus service month grain.

[Recognized Service Revenue] is before service-month credits. [Contribution Margin] is recognized revenue less service-month credits and attributed service cost; [Margin Percent] is a pooled ratio, not an average of account ratios.
[Posted Credits] on 'Credits' uses posting month. 'Credits'[service_month] is separate, and Credits has no contract_key; do not join credits to SLA contracts.
'Billing Account Map' uses half-open validity. billing_key is not account_key, even when integers match. Prefer the canonical account_key already present in Account Month.
Ask for service month versus posting month, and gross recognized versus net revenue, when unspecified. Keep one Finance row per selected account-month, regardless of the number of affected contracts.

recommendedDescriptions.description: Recognized service revenue in integer cents before service-month credits. Query by account service month, not contract or posting date.
Net recognized service revenue less attributed service cost, in cents by account-month. Not contract-attributed margin.
